extracted.intended_audience: media professionals and journalists who regularly cover the NBA (reporters, broadcasters, team public relations staff)
extracted.subtask_description: Procedures, eligibility rules, contact lists, and resource-access instructions for media covering the NBA, including how to use Media Central and how to obtain league photos, footage, audio, and credential information. Also includes criteria for certain NBA communications awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media Central membership eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: The Media Central Web site (http://mediacentral.nba.com) is a password-protected site that is restricted to media who regularly cover the NBA.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Membership grants access to box scores, team game notes, archives of press releases sorted by team and by date, NBA News archives, week-by-week team and league statistics, credential applications and biographies of referees and league executives; the site is updated continuously to provide up-to-the-moment information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media Central preview access (temporary)
rubrics_metrics.description: Not yet a member, to preview the site, please go to http://mediacentral.nba.com and type nbamedia to preview the site.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This will grant you 48-hour access, during which time you can review site features; follow on-screen links to recover forgotten member name/password.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media Central login and account recovery
rubrics_metrics.description: Already a member, please go to http://mediacentral.nba.com, type in your member name and password and click on the Login link.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you forgot your member name and/or password, there are links on this page to have the system send you that information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media Central registration process
rubrics_metrics.description: To register for the site, please visit mediacentral.nba.com/register.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you have any questions or feedback about the site, contact Brad Weinstein (bweinstein@nba.com) or Katerina Kienle (kakienle@nba.com). The directory also recommends requesting access to the media-only @NBACommsMR account for media operations updates during league events.

rubrics_metrics.name: NBA Hotline access procedure
rubrics_metrics.description: The NBA Hotline is a web page that enables TV and radio outlets to download audio game highlights from the broadcasts of every team, in addition to sound bites from players and coaches.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To access the NBA Hotline, log on to Media Central and choose 'NBA Hotline' under the 'Press Row' drop-down menu on the site’s navigation bar. Select the desired team or other entity. To access the audio, click on the link and either choose open or save. For further information, contact Mark Broussard at (212) 407-8580.

rubrics_metrics.name: NBA footage licensing procedure
rubrics_metrics.description: NBA Entertainment has the world’s most complete archive of footage from NBA games and will license video to media outlets for their journalistic uses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Please fax all requests for video information, prices and ordering instructions to NBA Entertainment’s Footage Licensing Department at (201) 590-3693.

rubrics_metrics.name: NBA Photos licensing procedure
rubrics_metrics.description: Newspapers, magazines, online services and any other media may choose photographs from NBA Photos’ library via Getty Images.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contact Michael Klein at Getty Images (michael.klein@gettyimages.com) for photo information, prices and ordering instructions. For questions, contact Joe Amati or Brian Choi at NBA Entertainment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of directory contact points for communications
rubrics_metrics.description: The Media Directory lists NBA Communications contacts, international communications contacts, team basketball communications and affiliated service contacts to be used for press matters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Media should contact the listed individual(s) for specific communications, media operations, credential or content requests (each listing includes office/ cell numbers and email addresses).

rubrics_metrics.name: Facility access and media entrance protocols
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific directions and entry procedures are provided for team facilities and arenas (example: MedStar Health Performance Center / Capital One Arena).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: WILL CALL WINDOW: F Street Entrance. PRESS ENTRANCE: 6th Street between F and G. MEDIA PARKING AREA: None — several pay lots nearby. For practice facilities: enter 'Entertainment and Sports Arena' in GPS; media entrance located across the street from parking garage; walk down loading dock ramp, go through gate marked media entrance, check in with security and proceed to media room.

rubrics_metrics.name: Credential applications availability
rubrics_metrics.description: Credential applications and related credential information are available via Media Central.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Media Central membership includes access to credential applications; the directory points media to the site for applying and for credential-related resources (no additional approval criteria are listed on this page).

rubrics_metrics.name: Team-specific media operations contacts and social handles
rubrics_metrics.description: Each team section provides the names, titles, contact numbers, emails and PR social handles (X/Twitter) of team communications staff.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Media should use these team-specific contacts and PR X handles for team-level media operations, press inquiries, and to request team materials or interviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Awards — Splaver/McHugh 'Tribute to Excellence' Award criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: The Splaver/McHugh 'Tribute to Excellence' Award is presented by the NBA Public Relations Directors Association to a current or former member of the NBA public relations family who has demonstrated an outstanding level of performance and service during his or her NBA career.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Background on namesakes and a list of past winners is provided to illustrate award history and standards of achievement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Awards — Brian McIntyre Media Relations Award criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: The Brian McIntyre Media Relations Award is presented by the Professional Basketball Writers Association to an NBA Public Relations staff that exemplifies the standards of professionalism and excellence worthy of acclaim.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The directory summarizes McIntyre's contributions to NBA communications policy and lists past organizational winners to indicate the kinds of programs recognized.

rubrics_metrics.name: Availability of additional seasonal media guides and publications
rubrics_metrics.description: Seasonal Media Guides and the Official NBA Guide are produced throughout the year and are available on Media Central (events such as NBA Tip-Off, Emirates NBA Cup, All-Star, Playoffs, Finals, Draft, Summer League).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These publications feature records, statistics, team directories, schedules, staff lists and other information useful for media coverage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Affiliated services and third-party resource use
rubrics_metrics.description: The directory lists affiliated services (e.g., Elias Sports Bureau, Sportradar, Hoop Magazine) including contact points and availability notes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Media should contact those third parties directly for specialized data, services or publications; some services note 24x7x365 availability or direct staff email/phone contacts.
